item.title: Draft ordinance amendment on registration renewal and audits for drone training institutions
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism published a draft amendment to the Ministerial Ordinance on Registered Training Institutions and Registered Renewal Training Institutions for Unmanned Aircraft for public comment on 2026-11-27; the stated deadline is 2026-12-28 00:00 JST. The draft would add registration-renewal procedures for these institutions and allow omission of external audits for business years in which they provided no relevant training. The overview explains that institutional registrations expire unless renewed every three years, but the existing ordinance lacks specific renewal procedures; it also states that existing rules require annual external audits even when no training was conducted. The instrument being amended is Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism Ordinance No. 59 of 2022, operating under the Civil Aeronautics Act, Act No. 231 of 1952. The supplied excerpts do not establish the detailed proposed renewal procedures, conditions for omitting audits, or a commencement date. item.title: MOF announcement on transitional filing forms under Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act amendments
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-26, the Ministry of Finance announced transitional handling of notifications and reports under amendments to the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act and related instruments, with full enforcement planned for 2027-01-04 and full application from 2027-02-03. During the 2027-01-04 to 2027-02-02 transition, form selection generally depends on the date of the underlying act, not the submission date: old-form notifications cover acts completed by 2027-02-02 after review, while acts on or after 2027-02-03 require new-form notifications. New-form notifications can be submitted from 2027-01-04, but the notified act cannot occur before 2027-02-03 even if review finishes earlier; an old-form notification must be refiled using the new form if the act moves to that date or later. Reports generally use the old form for acts through 2027-02-02 and the new form for later acts, although reports submitted from 2027-01-04 for earlier acts may also use the new form. Original title: 外為法改正に伴う届出書及び報告書の取扱いについて（経過措置期間：令和9年1月4日～2月2日） Government Announcement | Ministry of Finance (MOF) | Published 2026-11-26 | First detected 2026-11-27 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: Cabinet Order on severe-disaster designation and aid for May–September 2026 rains and storms
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries announced on 2026-11-27 that the Cabinet had approved a Cabinet Order designating disasters caused by heavy rain and rainstorms from 2026-05-23 through 2026-09-30 as disasters of extreme severity and specifying financial assistance measures. Under the Act on Special Financial Assistance to Deal with Disasters of Extreme Severity, the order provides nationwide increases in national subsidies for restoration of public civil engineering facilities, farmland, agricultural facilities, forest roads and jointly used agricultural, forestry and fisheries facilities. For jointly used facilities owned by agricultural cooperatives and similar bodies, the stated subsidy rises from 20% to 50%, or 90% in municipalities designated by the Minister; qualifying drainage projects undertaken by land improvement districts or their federations receive a 90% subsidy. The excerpt's other percentage increases are historical five-year averages, not confirmed rates for individual projects. Promulgation and entry into force are scheduled for 2026-12-02.
